recipe.input: Six Intel 5300 receivers x 3 antennas x 30 subcarriers CSI amplitude, one transmit antenna
recipe.time: Per receiver, valid packets in arrival order partitioned into 300 contiguous nearly equal bins and averaged; no sliding windows
recipe.channels: 540 = receiver x antenna x subcarrier, receiver-major
recipe.normalization: One scalar z-score per complete instance; float64 accumulation, sample SD floor 1e-6
recipe.exclusion: Instances with a missing or empty receiver file or fewer than 300 valid packets in any receiver are skipped and listed
